text:
Mika T.: Hi all  excited to join! Quick security/onboarding q's: 1) My corp laptop is delayed, can I work on personal Mac for a few days? 2) The phish-sim email looked legit  should I click or report now? 3) I need sandbox KMS for a quick demo  what's the fastest path? 4) How do I prove FileVault is enabled when I enroll?

Mira (People Ops): Welcome Mika :wave: Short answers: personal Mac OK temporarily if you enroll in MDM and enable FileVault, but request a loaner if you need elevated access. Report the phish-sim via the mail client "Report Phish" or forward to phishing@redwood.infra  don't click attachments. For KMS, open an infra ticket and include manager approval and demo window. To prove FileVault, paste `fdesetup status` output into the ticket.

IT Helpdesk: @Mika T. If you choose BYOD, follow the BYOD checklist: https://redwood.infra/byod. Minimal steps: install MDM, enable FileVault, and add Okta Verify/approved MFA. If you want a loaner, select "Loaner Device" in the ticket form. Example mac check: `fdesetup status` -> should read "FileVault is On".

Security Team: For sandbox KMS access we typically grant `kms:DevSandboxDecrypt` for up to 48h with manager sign-off and completed Data Handling acknowledgement. If your demo uses synthetic data and your manager signs, we can expedite. Phish sims are mandatory for new hires and used for training; reporting won't be punitive.

Mika T.: Thanks  couple follow-ups: can I use Authy desktop for MFA until my YubiKey arrives? And if I accidentally clicked a link, what should I do immediately?

IT Helpdesk: Desktop Authy on a personal device is allowed temporarily. For corp-managed machines we prefer Okta Verify or YubiKey. If you clicked a suspicious link, disconnect from VPN, change passwords if prompted, and DM Security with the URL.

Security Team: Exactly  reporting first, then DM us. We'll triage and advise next steps. Also complete the short Data Handling mini-quiz in the LMS; it's required before some sandbox roles are granted.

Mira (People Ops): I'll open the BYOD/loaner ticket for you now and tag IT + Security. Onboard Bot: Security mini-quiz due in 4 days. Phishing sim window: 1769980000 - 1770066400.
